rule: Actions must reference segment/profile, never technical cluster number.
Historical segmentation does not prove an action maximizes incremental outcome.
Discount magnitude requires experiment, margin constraints, and response data.
Recent/new customers have weak preference evidence.
Age/membership variables must not be described as drivers unless used by the model.
Segment-popular unbought category is a hypothesis, not a best-next-product prediction.
Review segment profiles and strategy mapping after retraining or major behavior shifts.
Use controlled experiments or causal methods before claiming treatment effectiveness.
